correctness.rationale: Rank preservation in the face-poset subdivision makes each simplex closure inject into the quotient: orbit-equivalent points in a closure have identical supporting ranks, hence the same support, and the action fixes that support pointwise. Thus signed deletion of flag members gives the regular cell boundaries and unique active top cofaces really are free. Independently enumerated matching faces and strict flag orbits in replays/3_5_topology.py (run with argument 3), obtaining (125,586,768,300), and replayed all 300 stored collapse pairs, leaving (125,586,468). Independently contracted a spanning tree of the residual complex and used triangle relations with just one unknown edge to kill all 462 non-tree generators. This proves simple connectivity without relying on the packaged Tietze implementation or published connectivity bounds. The two-dimensional residual complex has Euler characteristic 7 and free H₂ of rank 6; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead give the integral wedge equivalence.
residual_risks: The verification is for rank four and the ordinary geometric orbit space only, not the homotopy quotient or a general-size result.
